title: Δ-Complex Cohomology Visualiser
summary: An interactive proof that computes the cohomology of the sphere, the torus and the real projective plane from Δ-complexes of two oriented triangles each. Glue and unfold the simplices, watch the corners collapse to vertex classes, and build every entry of ∂₂ and ∂₁ from a face map: delete vertex i, find the glued edge, compare orientations. Transpose to the coboundaries, see kernels and images as nested subgroups, and reduce δ¹ to Smith normal form, where RP²'s diag(1, 2) gives H² ≅ ℤ/2. Coefficients in ℤ, 𝔽₂ or 𝔽₃, guided and inspect modes, orientation flips that change signs but not cohomology, ∂² = 0 term by term, a side-by-side comparison, cup products by Alexander–Whitney, and a backwards trace from any symbol to the gluing. Offline, with a narrated beamdswitch deck.
